description:
List this account's calls, newest first, and get for each one its call_id, phone number, status, outcome, task and one-line summary. Compliance: read-only, limited to this account's own calls; transcripts older than 90 days are deleted.

    Use it to find a call_id, to check whether a number was already called recently before placing a new call, or to answer questions such as 'what happened with my call to the garage?'. Read-only. For the full result and transcript of one call, use get_call with response_format='detailed'.

outcome.description: Optional filter on the call outcome.
outcome.title: Outcome

query.description: Optional text searched in the task, the summary, the transcript and the phone number (e.g. 'garage', '0561'). Empty = all calls.
query.title: Query

name: list_calls
title: List calls
